title: MAINT — conflict-marker scanner + CI job (the storage burn)
desc:
DELIVERABLE: tools/scan_conflicts.py walks a repo tree, exits 1 listing any file containing <<<<<<<, ======= or >>>>>>> (ignoring .git); .github/workflows/conflicts.yml runs it on every push; tests cover both outcomes. Storage once merged a PUSHES.md with committed markers — this makes that impossible.
EVIDENCE: clean tree exits 0; a fixture file with markers exits 1 naming the file; CI job green on the PR.
OWNS: tools/scan_conflicts.py, tests/test_scan_conflicts.py, .github/workflows/conflicts.yml
BRANCH: agent/<you>/<task-id>
